other_conditions: Must be unemployed and not employed in government, PSU, private sector, or self‑employed
Must be a bonafide Himachali resident
Must have passed at least 10+2 from a board/university recognised by the Himachal Pradesh Government
Must be registered with an Employment Exchange in Himachal Pradesh for at least one year as on the date of application
Must not be a dismissed government employee
Must not have any conviction resulting in imprisonment of 48 hours or more
Must not be a regular student pursuing any course
Must not be availing the Skill Development Allowance
benefits_summary: Monthly allowance of ₹1,000 for eligible unemployed youth, or ₹1,500 for physically challenged persons, payable for up to two years.
documents_required: Attested Copy of Employment Registration Card
Attested Copy of Income Certificate (not more than 6 months old)
Himachal Pradesh Unemployment Allowance Scheme Self Certified Declaration Form C
Attested Copy of Domicile of Himachal Pradesh
Attested Copy of all the Educational Qualification Certificates
